$comment: Per-file strictNullChecks allowlist. RETIRED AS A GATE, NOT DELETED: it reached 100% of src on 2026-10-02, so strictNullChecks is now ON globally in tsconfig.json and this config adds nothing — `test/typecheck-gate.mjs` hard-fails if the file is absent, so it is kept as a redundant double-check on the historically-graduated set rather than removed. History, for anyone reading the diff: the whole-project flip has no per-file granularity, so modules graduated ONE AT A TIME — the main tsconfig EXCLUDED every file listed here, and each had to hold strictNullChecks + noUncheckedIndexedAccess clean. The config also SNC-checked every file the listed ones transitively IMPORTED, so a closure leaf had to stay clean even when it had not graduated itself. Graduated: the whole client half (cards/account-form/panel-page), the host data/parse layer (state-store/catalog-store/parsers/llm-models), the switch/diagnostic stores (provider-store/doctor). The qr/draw/raccoon-* graduates retired together with their modules (2026-11-03 module cleanup).
